dedupe_keys.name: globalrice20 global 20 m paddy rice maps for 2015 and 2024

description: Global maps of paddy rice fields at 20 m for two years. The Zenodo record says GlobalRice20 maps paddy rice worldwide for 2015 and 2024 using a time-series-to-vision framework that turns optical and radar series from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8 into 2D images, which handles cloud cover and missing data in the tropics. It reports 92.33 per cent overall accuracy and strong agreement with national statistics. Data are binary uint8 GeoTIFFs in EPSG:4326 split into 45 by 45 degree tiles, one per tile and year (42 files), free to download under CC BY 4.0, published 11 January 2026. Coverage is global. Caveats: only two years and no cropping intensity. For simulation it locates rice land exposed to floods, drought and storms, and shows how it changed over a decade. A related catalogue record is the Monsoon Asia paddy rice intensity and planting dates dataset.
